mapper.sql: select account_id, account_code, account_name, account_type, bank_name, bank_no, opening_balance, current_balance, is_default, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from fin_account
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' then current_balance else 0 end), 0) as totalBalance, ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' and account_type = 'bank' then current_balance else 0 end), 0) as bankBalance, ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' and account_type in ('wechat', 'alipay') then current_balance else 0 end), 0) as onlineBalance, ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' and account_type = 'cash' then current_balance else 0 end), 0) as cashBalance, count(case when status = '0' then 1 end) as activeCount from fin_account
mapper.update: update fin_account set is_default = 'N' where is_default = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into fin_account ( account_code, account_name, account_type, bank_name, bank_no, opening_balance, current_balance, is_default, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{accountType}, #{bankName}, #{bankNo}, #{openingBalance}, #{currentBalance}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update fin_account set current_balance = #{currentBalance}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: insert into fin_account_journal ( journal_no, account_id, account_name, direction, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, target_name, amount, before_balance, after_balance, occur_time, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{journalNo}, #{accountId}, #{accountName}, #{direction}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{targetName}, #{amount}, #{beforeBalance}, #{afterBalance}, ifnull(#{occurTime}, sysdate()), #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

( select count(*) from wms_outbound where status = 'submitted' and create_time >= str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') and create_time < date_add(str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 month) ) + ( select count(*) from wms_sale_return where status = 'submitted' and create_time >= str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') and create_time < date_add(str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 month) ) + ( select count(*) from wms_purchase_return where status = 'submitted' and create_time >= str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') and create_time < date_add(str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 month) ) + ( select count(*) from wms_inventory_check where status = 'submitted' and create_time >= str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') and create_time < date_add(str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), date_add(str_to_date(concat(#{periodMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 month) ) as pendingBillCount
